title: Obstruct all coordinate-collinear actuator families nonlinearly
statement: If every actuator is parallel to a fixed COORDINATE e1, divergence-free force has form F(t,x2,x3)e1 with arbitrary admitted frequencies and switching. For U0=sqrt(2)M/sqrt(1+4pi^2) cos(2pi x3)e2, exact global smooth ansatz U=phi(t,x2,x3)e1+V(t,x3)e2 has V following pure heat and phi_t+V partial2 phi=nu Delta phi+F. Hence ||U(tau)||2>=M exp(-4pi^2 nu tau)/sqrt(1+4pi^2), independently of force. Zero disturbance is allowed, so this defeats an all-weak arbitrary-epsilon assertion for every such family. It is not a theorem about arbitrary non-coordinate directions or all multidirectional actuator families.
